test_defect_cancel_flag_set_before_deliv.summary: Active.cancel() sets 'cancelled' before delivery; a failed delivery is never retried by disposal

test_defect_dependency_roles_not_bound_t.summary: Admission hash-pins research_dependencies but never binds which file fills the observer / raw_output_reader role

test_defect_go_marks_started_before_deli.summary: Warm.go() marks the command started before the 'go' line is written; a broken pipe leaves command_started=True

test_defect_pre_go_failure_treated_as_li.summary: A pre-go failure disposes an UNSTARTED warm client as if it were a live owner: waits the full 110 s, sends a spurious `run cancel`, then reports a missing manifest and overwrites the primary stop state

test_defect_snapshot_failure_leaks_obser.summary: close_observer() snapshots before closing; a snapshot exception leaves the observer HANDLE open forever

test_defect_survival_bundle_not_preserve.summary: The exact survival input bundle is never persisted; a refused audit loses control_pre_cleanup/control_final

test_defect_transient_manifest_oserror_e.summary: A transient OSError while polling manifest.json escapes sample()/finish() and aborts a live case
